summary: There is no controlled evidence that tongue posture remodels adult facial bone. Claimed 'before/afters' are dominated by body-fat change, posture, camera angle and lighting.

evidence.what: No peer-reviewed trial has measured adult mandibular change from tongue posture.
evidence.source: Literature gap — orthodontic reviews of myofunctional therapy

risk.harmNote: Harmless on its own. The real cost is opportunity cost: months spent on mewing instead of body composition or sleep, which do change how a face reads.
